name: move where the fewest options remain
mechanism: at each step choose the move that leaves the fewest onward moves, so dead ends are consumed early rather than left stranded

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Warnsdorff's rule' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs: a heuristic method for solving the Knight's tour problem

requires: a count of onward options per move
fails_when: ties decide success on some boards; not guaranteed
